notes.concatenation_order: X448 shared secret (56 bytes) || sntrup761 shared secret (32 bytes)

v2_notes.combiner_description: combine_v2 binds the full encapsulation: it derives the hybrid shared secret from a fixed 184-byte BLAKE3 derive_key input under context 'trelis-hybrid-kem-v2'. Layout (X-Wing-shaped, classical-first): H(ct_sntrup)[0..32] || H(x448_eph)[32..64] || H(pk_hybrid)[64..96] || ss_x448[96..152] || ss_sntrup[152..184]. Each variable-length wire component is hashed to 32 bytes with BLAKE3. This binds ct_sntrup / x448_eph / pk_hybrid so MAL-BIND-K-CT / MAL-BIND-K-PK hold under BLAKE3 collision-resistance alone (CMB-01 / v1.5 F02).
v2_notes.reproduction: ct_sntrup and pk_hybrid are uniform fills reconstructed as [fill; size]; x448 shared secret, sntrup761 shared secret, and x448 ephemeral are given as full hex.
